childOutputNeverDrained.text: [[undrained]], so output past the pipe buffer blocks the child and [[stuck]]. [[repair]]

undrained.TypeScript: {{stream}} of this child is never read before its {{event}} is awaited
undrained.Swift: `{{pipe}}`, the pipe `{{process}}` writes its {{stream}} to, is not read to its end on some path before `{{process}}.waitUntilExit()`

repair.TypeScript: Read it (`child.{{stream}}.on('data', ...)`, or pipe it), or pass `'ignore'` or `'inherit'` in stdio.
repair.Swift: Read it to its end before the wait (`{{pipe}}.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile()`), or drain it with a `readabilityHandler` set before the wait, or give the stream `FileHandle.nullDevice` when nothing needs it.

pipeUnreadAtWait.text: The {{stream}} pipe is not read before `{{wait}}` on some path here, so output past the 64 KB pipe buffer blocks the child and `{{wait}}` never returns. Read it to its end first (`io.ReadAll`, or a goroutine copying it, started before the wait), or give the command a buffer or `os.Stdout` instead of a pipe.

childOutputNeverRead.text: `{{process}}` writes its {{stream}} to a `Pipe()` nothing reads, and some path waits for it at `{{process}}.waitUntilExit()`, so output past the pipe buffer blocks the child and the wait never returns. Give the stream `FileHandle.nullDevice` when nothing needs it, or keep the pipe in a `let` and read it to its end before the wait.
